turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I want to plan a nice Sunday together, help me choose.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a long brunch at that new place by the river, followed by a walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a cooking class in the afternoon where we'd make fresh pasta together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could go to the art museum, which has a new exhibit opening this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What does your partner usually enjoy more, food or culture? If it's food, the cooking class is a great pick. You could even do the river walk after the museum.
